Method of Attack: Trojanized chat app stealing data from victims' devices
Stealing WhatsApp backup files in unencrypted form
Requests risky permissions including contacts, location, phone, SMS, storage, call logs, camera, and microphone
Exfiltrates call logs, contact lists, SMS messages, device location, basic device information, media and document files
Receives commands from C2 to delete files, contacts, and call logs
Delivered through invite-based download requiring valid credentials or registration
Uses trojanized versions of legitimate open-source instant messenger apps (OMEMO IM)
Attack Vector: Malicious APK distributed via invite-based website (bingechat[.]net and others)
Indicators of Compromise: crypt14, crypt12, crypt13, crypt18, crypt32 file extensions (WhatsApp backups)
